blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has expressed hope that Filipinos will realize that the government is “sincere” in its efforts to make the country better. In the season finale of the “Unshaken With Gary V” podcast, which aired Monday, Marcos had a two-hour candid conversation with Filipino music icon Gary Valenciano about his childhood, the period when the Marcos family was exiled to Hawaii, and his eventual election as president. Toward the end of the podcast, Valenciano asked Marcos what words of encouragement he would like to give the public. READ: Bongbong Marcos gets ‘Unshaken’ in rare sit-down with Gary […]...
